support_claim: Commercial notes explicitly state that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, and the contract counterparty (Helion Robotics Ltd.) matches the billed entity (Helion Robotics Limited) under that established identity.

critic.reason: The packet cites commercial notes that explicitly establish Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited as the same legal entity, together with the contract header naming Helion Robotics Ltd. as counterparty and invoice rows billing Helion Robotics Limited, which jointly establish that the billing referent and the MSA-HELION-2019 counterparty are the same entity.
